name: qb64rust
description: QB64 language support: highlighting, live errors, check, build, run and debug with the new compiler qb64rust (bundled), formatting with QB64pe.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Highlighting works everywhere. Checking, formatting, building and running call the compiler, and the language server runs the qb64rust binary: they need a trusted workspace.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Only highlighting works. Checking, formatting, building and running need files on disk and a local compiler.

qb64rust.compilerPath.markdownDescription: Full path to `qb64pe.exe` (or `qb64pe`). When empty, `qb64pe` is looked up on `PATH`.

enumDescriptions: The new compiler qb64rust when it is found (bundled, `qb64rust.path` or PATH), else QB64pe.
Always qb64rust; a build fails when it is not found.
qb64rust.buildWith.markdownDescription: Which compiler **Build**, **Build and Run** and the build task use. `qb64rust` builds with a C++ toolchain: QB64pe's when QB64pe is found, else the one the first build offers to download (`qb64rust.toolchainPath` names one of your own). `qb64pe` needs QB64pe (`qb64rust.compilerPath`).

qb64rust.toolchainPath.markdownDescription: A C++ toolchain folder for building and debugging with `qb64rust` (llvm-mingw's layout: `bin\c++.exe`, `bin\mingw32-make.exe`, `bin\lldb-dap.exe`). When empty, QB64pe's toolchain when QB64pe is found, else the one installed by **QB64: Install the C++ Toolchain** (asked for at the first build: a 190 MB download from github.com/mstorsjo/llvm-mingw).

qb64rust.path.markdownDescription: Full path to the `qb64rust` binary (the new compiler), which runs the language server (syntax errors as you type, the outline, folding, go to definition, the check on save) and builds. When empty, the binary that comes with the extension, else `qb64rust` on `PATH`.

qb64rust.includeRoot.markdownDescription: Where the language server and a build with `qb64rust` look up `$INCLUDE` files after the including file's folder (`qb64rust --include-root`). When empty, the QB64pe folder (as QB64pe looks in its own folder), else the folder of the `qb64rust` binary. A relative path is resolved against the workspace folder (without a workspace folder it is ignored).

qb64rust.checkOnSave.description: Check the program with the compiler (C++ generation only, no build) when a file is saved.

qb64rust.checkTimeoutSeconds.description: A check or format that runs longer than this is stopped.

qb64rust.format.autoIndent.markdownDescription: Format Document indents each block (QB64pe's IDE setting *Auto indent*, `-f:autoindent`).

qb64rust.format.indentSubs.markdownDescription: Indent the body of a `SUB` or `FUNCTION` (`-f:indentsubs`).

qb64rust.format.autoLayout.markdownDescription: Space each statement and spell its keywords and names (`-f:autolayout`). When off, only the indent changes.

qb64rust.format.keywordCase.markdownDescription: The case of keywords in Format Document. These settings take the place of QB64pe's `config.ini`, which plays no part in formatting.

qb64rust.runArguments.markdownDescription: Arguments passed to the program by **Run** (visible to it as `COMMAND$`).

qb64rust.noPrompt.markdownDescription: Set `QB64PE_NOPROMPT=y` when running a program, so untrapped runtime errors are printed instead of shown in a dialog.

action.description: Build the program, or run its executable.

file.description: The .bas file. Defaults to the active editor's file.

program.description: The program to debug: its main .bas file, built with qb64rust --debug before the launch, or the executable of a debug build. Defaults to the active file.

args.description: Arguments passed to the program (its COMMAND$). Defaults to qb64rust.runArguments.

cwd.description: The program's working folder. Defaults to the program's folder.

stopOnEntry.description: Stop at the program's first BASIC line.

enumDescriptions: VS Code's integrated terminal: the program's console output and its keyboard input (INPUT) are there.
The Debug Console: output only; the program gets no keyboard input from it.
A terminal window outside VS Code.
console.description: Where a $CONSOLE program reads and writes. A program with a window of its own opens it as when run.

noPrompt.description: Set QB64PE_NOPROMPT=y, so untrapped runtime errors are printed instead of shown in a dialog. Defaults to qb64rust.noPrompt.

configurationSnippets.label: QB64: Debug program
configurationSnippets.description: Build the program with qb64rust --debug and debug it.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:grammar && npm run test:integration && npm run test:integration:min
scripts.package: npm run stage && vsce package --target win32-x64
